items.difficulty_reason: 7 行（含 10 行陈述）、lqf 的 f_!/f^! 提升为 derived 伴随对：Derived Categories 导出伴随引理（具名）+ f_! 正合（stalk 描述引理具名）hence Lf_! = f_! + K-injective 足够使 Rf^! 可定义。三输入全具名即完整路线，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lqf-shriek-derived (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2584-2593

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the derived adjoint functor lemma produces the adjoint pair on derived categories once f_! is exact (by the stalk description lemma) so Lf_! = f_!, and enough K-injective complexes exist so that Rf^! is defined (source lines 2599-2606)
